checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan: add Huntley 2015 dementia cognition meta-analysis as context and cite it on the no-dementia-prevention boundary

impact_assessment.benefits: Adds a 33-study dementia meta-analysis to the boundary and reduces D7.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Verify via efetch, update records/references/counts/version, add citation with tests, run suites and review UI.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: one context record, one UI citation, count/version updates; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: counts, references and version must move together
impact_assessment.why: A verified 2015 meta-analysis found cognitive training did not improve general cognition in dementia and cognitive-stimulation gains on ADAS-Cog were generally not clinically significant, directly grounding the app's no-dementia and no-clinical-benefit boundaries.
